introduction: At GenoScene, we prioritize the security and privacy of your genetic information. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your data.

sections.title: Data Collection
content: DNA markers and genetic sequences for analysis
Personal profile information (name, date of birth, email)
Device information and app usage analytics

sections.title: Security
content: 256-bit AES encryption for all genetic data at rest and in transit
Multi-factor authentication to access your account
Secure cloud infrastructure with regular security audits
De-identification protocols for research data sharing

sections.title: User Rights
content: Access: View all your stored data at any time
Export: Download your complete genetic data in standard formats
Delete: Request permanent deletion of your data within 30 days
Withdraw Consent: Opt out of research participation at any time
